name: 服务端周目管理 (Samsara)
description:
同一个存档，玩一辈子：周目更替不换档——新区域开局、三五成群分散出生、旧世界未圈地倒流退场、圈下的地永远保留；版本更新不跑图，旧区块重生成，新结构就在家门口。
One save, forever: seasons rotate without wiping the world — fresh spawn areas, grouped spawns, unclaimed land fading in a time rewind, your claims always kept; and when the game updates, old chunks regenerate so new structures spawn nearby.
